subject: Staged throughput uplift + SLA restructuring for 2027 renewal
messages:
From: Sam Kapoor <sam.kapoor@elarahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T15:02:00Z
Subject: Renewal prep — capacity forecast & ask for premium ops

Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the Q3 usage summary — good context. We are approaching our October renewal window and want to align on a path to upgrade support and capacity for 2027. A few bullets up front so we can be concrete in the renewal: 

- Current average token usage: ~1.1B tokens/month, 95th percentile burst to ~1.9B.
- We expect 40% YOY growth and several planned product launches (two features in H1 2027) that will raise steady-state to ~1.6B tokens/month with spikes to 2.6B during launches.
- Pain points today: tail latency variability during spikes (affects user experience) and limited burst headroom during coordinated campaigns.

Ask: Proposal for a staged throughput uplift (reserve additional dedicated capacity in two waves) plus a premium SLA (improved latency SLOs and faster priority support response). We want clarity on: pricing for staged reserve, definition of the latency SLO at p50/p95/p99, on-call escalation flow, change-control to avoid regressions during model swaps, and a timeline that ties to our product roadmap.

I attached the PO draft and initial traffic forecast. Can we get a written proposal by 2026-09-10 so procurement can review ahead of the renewal?

Thanks,

Sam Kapoor
VP, Platform
Elara Health
sam.kapoor@elarahealth.com
(attachment: Elara_PO_20260922.pdf)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Kapoor <sam.kapoor@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — capacity forecast & ask for premium ops

Sam — thanks for the clear context and the PO. We can absolutely support a staged reserve and tighten SLOs; below is a pragmatic path we use for customers with similar growth profiles: 

1) Phased capacity uplift
   - Phase 1 (Nov 2026): Reserve +50% baseline capacity to cover steady growth and near-term launches. This is a guaranteed reserved pool on Dedicated.
   - Phase 2 (Mar 2027): Additional +25% reserve if steady-state usage meets the projected thresholds (automated metering check).

2) SLA / latency SLOs (example targets we can commit to in the addendum)
   - p50 <= 40ms (generation latency)
   - p95 <= 160ms
   - p99 <= 350ms (with documented mitigation and fallbacks for extreme tail events)
   - Uptime SLA: 99.95% for the dedicated pool

3) Support and escalation
   - Priority support channel with sub-1h initial response for Sev 1; 4h for Sev 2.
   - Named on-call rotation during major launches; runbook and pre-launch checklist to be signed off 14 days prior.

4) Operational controls
   - Canary model rollouts + automatic rollback on inferred quality regressions (we provide the guardrails and a verification window).
   - Traffic shaping and burst credits to smooth scheduled campaigns.

Commercials: I'll ask Marissa/Ben to propose the staged pricing and a one-time migration/onboarding fee. As a quick reference, Phase 1 reserved uplift generally carries a 20–25% uplift on our standard unit rates; Phase 2 uses a lower incremental uplift if committed. We can also offer a small launch credit tied to the PO size.

I'll put a draft SLA addendum and a staged throughput plan in a follow-up today so you have text for procurement. If that looks good, can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week (I have 9–11am PT Wed or Thu)?

—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
(attachment: throughput-plan.xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:10:00Z
Subject: RE: Renewal prep — capacity forecast & ask for premium ops

Irene / Ben — quick internal note before we finalize language for procurement.

- Pricing sketch: Phase 1 (50% reserve) = +22% on committed unit rate; Phase 2 (additional 25%) = +12% on incremental reserved units when committed. One-time onboarding: USD 25k. Launch credit: USD 10k applied after first quarter of Phase 1 if baselines met.
- Discount guardrails: we can push to 18–20% overall effective uplift if Elara signs a 12-month committed renewal with annual billing.
- Legal asks: standard SLA metrics are fine; request from Legal to limit remedies to service credits not termination. Also need to include a data-flow appendix (they often ask for this for healthcare customers).

Action items: Ben, please draft the procurement-facing commercial summary (numbers + renewal term) and legal the initial redline if possible by 9/6. Irene, I can take point on the commercial note to Sam once Ben drops the numbers.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Sam Kapoor <sam.kapoor@elarahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — capacity forecast & ask for premium ops

Thanks, Irene — that looks like the right structure. Procurement has reviewed the PO and attached a signed copy (see attached). A couple of operational asks from our side before final DocuSign: 

- We need the SOC 2 evidence for the dedicated pool and an outline of the change-control cadence for model swaps.
- Can you confirm the p99 definition includes end-to-end serving time (not just model compute)?

Forwarding procurement note below for traceability.

Date: 2026-09-29T11:06:00Z
Subject: Final: SLA addendum, DocuSign link, and rollout plan

Sam — thanks — attaching SLA_Addendum_v2.pdf which includes the exact SLO language, remedies (service credits), and the data-flow appendix for your procurement team. Quick checklist and next steps: 

- SOC 2: We provided a SOC 2 Type II for the dedicated environment in our secure portal. Link shared via secure transfer (procurement should have received the notification).
- p99 definition: Confirmed — the p99 in the addendum is measured end-to-end from request receipt at the edge to final token emission, excluding customer-side network transit. We included measurement windows and sampling guidance.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/1234-elara-sla (covers Phase 1 reservation and the 12-month committed term).
- Rollout plan: Phase 1 provisioning scheduled 2026-11-08 (provisioning + runbook verification). Launch support: named on-call 7 days before your campaign; canary window of 48 hours.
- Commercials: Marissa has confirmed Phase 1 pricing (22% uplift) and onboarding fee USD 25k; final invoice will be generated on DocuSign execution.

Please countersign the DocuSign by 2026-10-06 for the provisioning timeline to hold. Procurement/Legal: if you need any redlines, send to legal@redwood.com; Ben is prepping the clause language we discussed (limiting remedies to service credits).

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (DEAL-ELR-2026-09).

Best,

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
